subject: Transportation Systems
title: The Levels of Autonomy
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Levels of Autonomy.

hook.text: Self-driving cars aren't a single technology. There are six levels, and most cars are stuck at level two.

buildup.text: Level 0 is no automation. Level 2 is hands-on assist—cruise control with lane keeping. Most Tesla Autopilot is here.

discovery.text: Level 4 means the car drives itself in specific conditions—a mapped city, clear weather, defined routes.

twist.text: Level 5—full autonomy everywhere, in all conditions—doesn't exist yet. No company has achieved it.

climax.text: The gap between level 2 and level 5 is enormous. Most of the unsolved problems live in that gap.

punchline.text: Self-driving exists. Self-driving everywhere does not.

quiz.question: What level of autonomy do most current self-driving features operate at?
